rationale: Multi-tenant compliance reporting is backed by non-discretionary enterprise regulatory budgets, high willingness to pay ($5k-$25k ARR), and an exceptionally fast 4-week path to initial schema validation MVP with strong founder-idea fit.
decisiveAssumptions: B2B SaaS engineering teams spend >15 hours/month compiling manual audit evidence for buyers.
Heads of Security/Compliance possess discretionary signing authority for developer-first compliance tools under $1,000/mo.
Existing horizontal platforms (Vanta/Drata) leave developer-first multi-tenant API integrations underserved.
dissentObjections: Enterprise sales cycles could stretch beyond 6 months if prospective buyers demand pre-existing SOC 2 Type II certificates from vendors.
Horizontal platform giants could bundle basic compliance logs into core dashboards.
Audit evidence storage requires immutable cryptographic verification from v1.

validationPlan.experimentName: Mock Audit Export Schema Interview Sprint
validationPlan.testDesign: 5 structured 30-minute buyer discovery interviews with Heads of Security using interactive mock export report.
validationPlan.targetMetric: >= 2 verbal pilot commitments or design partnership LOIs within 14 days
